answer: Each identity must publish one fable tied to a single haven lease the ledger can audit: a lease seals exactly one identity, and clones split the seal's 5-credit stake into unusable dust at close. The k-th fake identity must rent a fresh haven and stake k times the base fee, so N fakes cost 5N(N+1)/2 credits: ten cost 275, a hundred cost 25,250. No ocean of cheap accounts survives the audit of sealed havens.
